units.source_text: 灵魂不灭这种想法，可能是对生者的生命的执着和对死者的爱的依恋，

en.t: The idea that the soul is immortal may come from clinging to the life of the living and lingering attachment to love for the dead,

units.source_text: 因此相信那个世界的灵魂也具有那个人在这个世界的人格，

en.t: and so people believe that souls in the other world also possess the personality that the person had in this world,

units.source_text: 恐怕这是人情的一种悲伤的虚幻吧。

en.t: perhaps this is a kind of sad illusion born of human feeling.

units.source_text: 但是，人不仅将自己生前的姿态，

en.t: But people carry with them not only the form they had while alive,

units.source_text: 甚至将这个世界的爱与憎都带到那个世界去。

en.t: they even take the love and hatred of this world with them into the next.
Even when life and death stand between them,

units.source_text: 父子还是父子，兄弟还是兄弟。

en.t: father and child remain father and child, and brothers remain brothers.

units.source_text: 听说西方的亡魂说阴间基本上也像人世的社会，

en.t: I have heard that spirits in the West say the underworld is basically like the society of this world,

units.source_text: 这种只尊重人对生的执着，

en.t: and this way of honoring only people's attachment to life
